# CompTIA

> CompTIA is a leading provider of IT, cybersecurity, AI, and data certifications with training programs designed for career advancement across enterprise, government, and academic sectors.

CompTIA offers comprehensive certification pathways and workforce development resources across multiple industries and educational levels. The platform serves enterprise organizations, government agencies, academic institutions, and individual learners seeking to build tech skills and advance their careers.

## Key Topics

- IT Certifications
- Cybersecurity Training
- Career Pathways
- Workforce Development
- Cloud Computing
- AI and Data
- Security+
- Tech Skills
- Job Roles
- Career Advancement
- Higher Education
- Government IT
- Enterprise Training
- CertMaster
- Careers+

## Certifications & Core Platform

- [Information Technology (IT) Certifications & Tech Training | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-US): CompTIA homepage offering IT certifications, training, and exam resources.
- [IT, AI, and Data Certifications | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications): Comprehensive catalog of CompTIA certifications across IT, AI, data.

## Career Exploration & Development

- [Explore Tech Careers and Industry Pathways | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/explore-careers): Explore tech careers, industry pathways, and job roles with salary insights.
- [Careers+ | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/explore-careers/careers-plus): CompTIA Careers+ tool for career exploration and job profile guidance.
- [Industry Sectors | CompTIA](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/explore-careers/industry-sectors): Discover technology innovation across cybersecurity, AI, cloud, networking.

## Enterprise & Organizational Solutions

- [Upskill Your Tech Teams | CompTIA for Enterprise](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/enterprise): Enterprise training and certification programs for tech team upskilling.
- [Become a CompTIA Training Delivery Partner | CompTIA for Partners](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/partner): Partner program for training delivery and certification exam administration.

## Government Solutions

- [Government IT Certifications | CompTIA for Government](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/government): Government-focused IT certifications for federal and state agencies.
- [Federal Government IT Certifications | CompTIA for Government](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/government/federal): Federal government IT certifications for DoD, military, and agencies.
- [State & Local Government IT Certifications | CompTIA for Government](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/government/state-and-local): State and local government IT training and certification solutions.

## Academic Programs

- [Academic IT Certifications | CompTIA for Education](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic): Academic IT certifications and resources for higher and secondary education.
- [Academic IT Certifications | CompTIA for Higher Education](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/higher-education): Higher education IT solutions with certifications and career pathways.
- [Academic IT Certifications | CompTIA for Secondary Education](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/secondary-education): Secondary education IT certification pathways and state-aligned programs.
- [Academic IT Certifications | CompTIA for Instructors](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/instructor): Instructor resources, curriculum tools, and academic pricing solutions.
- [Academic IT Certifications | CompTIA for Students](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/student): Student certifications and career resources bridging education to industry.

## Resources & Research

- [CompTIA Resources](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/resources): Central hub for CompTIA learning resources, tools, and research.
- [CompTIA Research](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/resources/research): Research reports on tech jobs, workforce trends, and industry outlook.
